title: Fixed-object dg model structure and derived free graph adjunction
statement:
Use the universe and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the projective model of unbounded cochain complexes $\mathbf V=\operatorname{Ch}(\mathbf Z)$ of [lem-coef-projective-chains-monoidal-model]. Let $W$ be the quasi-isomorphisms of complexes and fix a small set $S$. An $S$-graph is a family $P(s,t)$ of complexes; its category $\mathbf G_S=\prod_{(s,t)\in S^2}\mathbf V$ has the objectwise projective model structure. Let $\mathbf C_S$ be strict dg categories with object set $S$, associative unital chain-map composition $A(t,u)\otimes A(s,t)\to A(s,u)$, and functors equal to the identity on $S$. Put $\mathrm{FF}_S=\{f\mid f(s,t)\text{ is a quasi-isomorphism for every }s,t\}$. The forgetful functor $U:\mathbf C_S\to\mathbf G_S$ has a left adjoint $F$, the free dg category. Its mapping complex is
$$UF(P)(s,t)=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\ \bigoplus_{s=x_0,\ldots,x_n=t}P(x_{n-1},x_n)\otimes\cdots\otimes P(x_0,x_1).$$
For $n=0$ the summand is $\mathbf Z[0]$ if $s=t$ and is absent otherwise. Composition concatenates paths; the unit of $F\dashv U$ inserts length-one paths.

There is a combinatorial model structure on $\mathbf C_S$ with weak equivalences $\mathrm{FF}_S$ and fibrations the mappingwise degreewise surjections. Here a model structure has retract-closed weak equivalences satisfying two-out-of-three and two weak factorization systems (cofibrations, trivial fibrations) and (trivial cofibrations, fibrations), with functorial factorizations; trivial means also a weak equivalence, and cofibrant means that the map from the initial object is a cofibration. All objects are fibrant, $F\dashv U$ is Quillen (the left adjoint preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations), and a cofibrant object has cofibrant mapping complexes. There is a functorial cofibrant replacement $Q_SA\to A$ that is a trivial fibration and fixes $S$.

Writing $\mathcal D=\mathbf V[W^{-1}]_\infty$, objectwise localization identifies $\mathbf G_S[W_S^{-1}]_\infty$ with $\mathcal D^{S^2}$, where $W_S$ denotes the objectwise quasi-isomorphisms. With homotopy-coherent localization as defined in [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability], on these localizations the forgetful functor $U_\infty:\mathbf C_S[\mathrm{FF}_S^{-1}]_\infty\to\mathcal D^{S^2}$ is conservative (reflects equivalences), has a left adjoint $F_\infty$, and preserves geometric realizations and, more generally, colimits indexed by $N(I)$ for every small ordinary category $I$ whose nerve is sifted. A geometric realization is a colimit indexed by $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$; sifted means that colimits of spaces indexed by that shape commute with finite products. The left adjoint is computed by $F$ applied to an objectwise cofibrant graph. Its unit is insertion of length-one paths, and its underlying graph is the displayed direct sum with derived tensors and coproducts. These adjunction identifications are coherent, including the specified unit.

source.place: Haugseng Corollaries 3.14-3.15, Lemmas 3.19-3.20 and proof of Proposition 5.2(a),(c),(e),(f); structural inputs for the fixed-object comparison in ancestor proof paragraph 2. Online source read; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this homotopy-coherent theorem. The strict dg composition uses reverse tensor order; the source uses forward order, identified here by the Koszul symmetry of complexes. The sifted-colimit assertion is restricted to nerve-indexed shapes exactly as in Lemma 3.20; it includes geometric realizations.
